module.purpose: Defines the reactive Atom signal abstraction, its internal implementation, value updates, optional diff history, dependency capture, and public factory and type guards.
module.summary: This module implements mutable reactive signals whose values can be read, replaced, or updated. Changes are equality-checked, assigned global transaction epochs, optionally recorded as diffs, and propagated to dependent children. The public API is exposed through interfaces and a factory, while the concrete implementation remains internal and is retrieved through a singleton constructor reference.
module.businessContext: Supports state management and reactive application updates. Failure would prevent state changes from propagating, break dependency tracking, and make historical diff-based computations unavailable.
